## (d) Journey by Air.-  
- Government servants entitled to travel by air on LTC may travel
- (i) by private airlines.
- (ii) Booking of tickets are to be done directly from three authorized travel agents viz. Balmer and Lawrie and Company Ltd., Ashok Travels and Tours and IRCTC or from self-booking tool I on line booking website/ portal of 3 authorized agencies.
